notes.title: Sole Survivor Remake
notes.notes: Hi, Remake the first game, The Sole Survivor, which I replaced on the previous build. The previous build was not much playable, but now you can find the whole new game with new modes. In singleplayer mode, there are 3 challenging temples, and in every temple, you can find more than 4 traps in your way. In multiplayer mode, you have a limit on the number of players, and you can also change the player number to a maximum 10 players. You have to choose between Aztec and Mayan, break the pots, collect the coins, and not drop until the time runs out. The sandbox has a grid-based system, and there are more than 20 traps you can build and challenge yourself to complete.
